system: Chronicles of Swarajya: World Map & Regions Registry

sahyadri_gateway_valley.name: Sahyadri Gateway Valley (Connected Open World)
sahyadri_gateway_valley.biome: Monsoon Teak Forest, Koyna River Valley, Bhavani Nagar, Sahyadri Highlands & Kot Fortress

subZones.name: Sacred Awakening Forest
subZones.description: Lush monsoon teak groves where Shivaji awakens, gathers initial timber and ironstone, and forges his first blade.

subZones.name: Koyna River Valley
subZones.description: Swift mountain river spanned by a main timber footbridge and a northern shallow stone ford.

subZones.name: Sahyadri Highlands
subZones.description: Rugged basalt cliff switchbacks and wind-swept mountain passes overlooking the Koyna basin.

subZones.name: Highland Abandoned Mine Entrance
subZones.description: Craggy ironstone ridge housing the timber-shored entrance to the subterranean Sahyadri iron cavern.

subZones.name: Bhavani Nagar & Countryside
subZones.description: Settled Maratha village featuring a stone well, elder's wada, blacksmith forge, and surrounding countryside trails.

subZones.name: Deshmukh Raider Outpost
subZones.description: Hostile forward military encampment threatening Bhavani Nagar and guarding the southern supply road to Kot Fort.

subZones.name: Kot Fort Citadel & Approach
subZones.description: Monumental basalt walls, the iron-spiked Dilli Darwaja gate, fortified courtyard, and high Buruj flagstaff.

sahyadri_iron_cavern.name: Highland Abandoned Iron Mine (Interior Region)
sahyadri_iron_cavern.description: Registered 40x25 underground mine interior for future subterranean exploration, rare ore mining, and return-to-surface transitions.
